## LLM Pilot

```{r}
library(openxlsx)
```

```{r}

# File 1
# Excel-Datei laden
daten <- read.xlsx(xlsxFile = "Results_BinaryDecision 1.xlsx")

# Konvertiere die Spalten in das POSIXct-Datumsformat
daten$Date.started <- as.POSIXct(daten$`Date.started`, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
daten$Date.last_action <- as.POSIXct(daten$`Date.last.action`, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

# Berechne die Differenz zwischen den beiden Zeitstempeln
daten$Time.difference <- difftime(daten$Date.last.action, daten$Date.started, units="mins")

# Ausgabe anzeigen
#View(daten)

# Zeigt nur die Spalte 'Time_difference'
print(daten$Time.difference)

```

```{r}
# Convert the difftime to numeric (in minutes)
numeric.diff <- as.numeric(daten$Time.difference)

# Now get a proper summary of the time differences in numeric form
summary(numeric.diff)

```

```{r}
# new table
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

# Duration of the test conditions

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.align='left'}

  
# Extract statistics for each dataset
stats1 <- summary(numeric.diff)
stats2 <- summary(numeric.diff2)
stats3 <- summary(numeric.diff3)
stats4 <- summary(numeric.diff4)

# Create a data frame with Min, Median, Mean, and Max for each dataset
summary_table <- tibble(
  Dataset = c("Results_BinaryDecision 1", "Results_BWS (1)", "Results_AB (2)", "Results_DirectQuality (1)"),
  Min = c(stats1["Min."], stats2["Min."], stats3["Min."], stats4["Min."]),
  Median = c(stats1["Median"], stats2["Median"], stats3["Median"], stats4["Median"]),
  Mean = c(stats1["Mean"], stats2["Mean"], stats3["Mean"], stats4["Mean"]),
  Max = c(stats1["Max."], stats2["Max."], stats3["Max."], stats4["Max."])
)

# Create the publication-ready table using the gt package
publication_table <- summary_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  # Add column labels
  gt::cols_label(
    Dataset = "Dataset",
    Min = "Minimum",
    Median = "Median",
    Mean = "Mean",
    Max = "Maximum"
  ) %>%
  # Add the title
  gt::tab_header(
    title = "Descriptive Statistics for Test Duration"
  ) %>%
  # Bold the column labels
  gt::tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  # Format numeric columns to two decimal places
  fmt_number(
    columns = vars(Min, Median, Mean, Max),
    decimals = 2
  )

# Print the publication-ready table
publication_table

```

# Cost per participant

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.align='left'}
# Load necessary libraries
#library(tidyverse)
#library(gt)

# Define the hourly rate
hourly_rate <- 12

# Calculate the mean time for each dataset (in minutes) and convert to hours
mean_diff1 <- mean(numeric.diff) / 60  # Convert minutes to hours
mean_diff2 <- mean(numeric.diff2) / 60
mean_diff3 <- mean(numeric.diff3) / 60
mean_diff4 <- mean(numeric.diff4) / 60

# Calculate the cost for each dataset
cost1 <- mean_diff1 * hourly_rate
cost2 <- mean_diff2 * hourly_rate
cost3 <- mean_diff3 * hourly_rate
cost4 <- mean_diff4 * hourly_rate

# Create a data frame to display the results
cost_table <- tibble(
  Dataset = c("Results_BinaryDecision 1", "Results_BWS (1)", "Results_AB (2)", "Results_DirectQuality (1)"),
  Mean_Time_Hours = c(mean_diff1, mean_diff2, mean_diff3, mean_diff4),
  Mean_Cost_Euros = c(cost1, cost2, cost3, cost4)
)

# Create the publication-ready table 
publication_table <- cost_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    Dataset = "Dataset",
    Mean_Time_Hours = "Mean Time (Hours)",
    Mean_Cost_Euros = "Mean Cost (Euros)"
  ) %>%
  gt::fmt_currency(columns = vars(Mean_Cost_Euros), currency = "EUR") %>%
  gt::tab_header(
    title = "Cost and Time Analysis by Dataset"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(everything())
  )

# Print the formatted table
publication_table


```

# Cost by recommended test group size based on effect size calculation

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.align='left', }
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)

# Data from the table
mean_time_hours <- c(0.5436111, 0.6372778, 1.0236806, 0.4406111)
mean_cost_euros <- c(6.523333, 7.647333, 12.284167, 5.287333)
recommended_n_texts <- c(160, 153, 187, 13)  # Recommended n for "Comparison of 8 Texts"
recommended_n_llms <- c(382, 285, 299, 32)   # Recommended n for "Comparison of LLMs"

# Calculate the cost for each row by multiplying Mean_Cost_Euros with Recommended n
cost_texts <- mean_cost_euros * recommended_n_texts
cost_llms <- mean_cost_euros * recommended_n_llms

# Create a data frame to display the results
results <- tibble(
  Dataset = c("Results_BinaryDecision 1", "Results_BWS (1)", "Results_AB (2)", "Results_DirectQuality (1)"),
  Mean_Time_Hours = mean_time_hours,
  Mean_Cost_Euros = mean_cost_euros,
  Recommended_n_Texts = recommended_n_texts,
  Cost_Texts = cost_texts,
  Recommended_n_LLMs = recommended_n_llms,
  Cost_LLMs = cost_llms
)

# Convert the data frame into a publication-ready table with multi-level headers
publication_table <- results %>%
  gt() %>%
  # Add the multi-level header for "Comparison of 8 Texts" and "Comparison of LLMs"
  gt::cols_label(
    Dataset = "Dataset",
    Mean_Time_Hours = "Mean Time (Hours)",
    Mean_Cost_Euros = "Mean Cost (Euros)",
    Recommended_n_Texts = "Recommended n",
    Cost_Texts = "Cost",
    Recommended_n_LLMs = "Recommended n",
    Cost_LLMs = "Cost"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Comparison of 8 Texts",
    columns = vars(Recommended_n_Texts, Cost_Texts)
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Comparison of LLMs",
    columns = vars(Recommended_n_LLMs, Cost_LLMs)
  ) %>%
  # Format the currency columns with the EUR symbol
  fmt_currency(
    columns = vars(Mean_Cost_Euros, Cost_Texts, Cost_LLMs),
    currency = "EUR"
  ) %>%
  # Add a title to the table
  tab_header(
    title = "Cost and Time Analysis for Comparison of Tests and LLMs"
  ) %>%
  # Bold the column labels for clarity
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  )

# Print the table
publication_table

```
